title: Event: Trick or Treat
text: The Trick or Treat event is a custom event made to resemble real like Trick or Treating Daru on mirage gives a pumpkin filled with candies Same daru gives a basket to collect Place down pumpkin on your land to have a starting point Use basket, you have 15 mins to collect candies from every pumpkin you can find Event Times October 30th 2024 ~~ November 6th 2024
html:
The Trick or Treat event is a custom event made to resemble real like Trick or Treating

  1. Daru on mirage gives a pumpkin filled with candies
  2. Same daru gives a basket to collect
  3. Place down pumpkin on your land to have a starting point
  4. Use basket, you have 15 mins to collect candies from every pumpkin you can find

Event Times

October 30th 2024 ~~ November 6th 2024
